table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + 'Medicine' else item.name end, 
	users.username,  
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
	cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
	altersaleinvcode=max(dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
     balance=ISNULL(max(saleledger.balance), 0), 
	amt=max(saleledger.amt),  
	printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),
	associatedamt=0.00
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item,
	Users 

WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )

GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.headerno,
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks, 
	saledetail.icode, 
	saledetail.rowgroup,
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.icode,
	item.printable,
	item.customicode,
	users.username
UNION ALL
SELECT	 
	itemname = ISNULL((SELECT '*' + MachineName FROM SaleLedger WHERE SaleInvCode = AssocSaleInvCode) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(AssocSaleInvCode))) + ')', ''),
	users.username, 
	posted=dbo.saleledger.posted,
	salecat=saleledger.salecatcode,
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	icode=NULL,   
	gcode=NULL, 
	cashreceived=dbo.saleledger.cashreceived,
	Id        = 999999999999,  
	looseqty  = 0, 
	packqty   = 0, 
	packunits = 0, 
	saleprice = 0, 
	rate      = 0,
	salestax  = 0,   
	discperc  = 0, 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = 0,
	aliasname=NULL,
	machinename=',' + saleledger.machinename,
	altersaleinvcode= dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	reprintcounter=0,
	balance=isnull(dbo.saleledger.balance,0), 
	amt=dbo.saleledger.amt,  
	printbalance=dbo.saleledger.printbalance,
	associatedamt= DBO.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(L.AssocSaleInvCode)

FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	AssocSaleInvList L, 
	Users

WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = L.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode )
ORDER BY ID, ItemName

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum ( looseqty * saledetail_saleprice  for all )  + sum( associatedamt for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0) + sum( associatedamt for all)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: cashreceived - (Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)) - sum( associatedamt for all)
